bio: Evon Potter and her husband Bob owned and operated a Super Market for several years in Oklahoma City before joining The Navigators staff in 1962. At the age of 30 both she and her husband committed their lives to Christ at a Billy Graham Crusade in Oklahoma City. They have been married for more than 63 years. During the last 43 years Evon has been involved in their ministry, discipling wives and young women. They have three sons, six grandchildren and three great-grandchildren.

29787.t: What Is That In Your Hand
